verses.en: I was glad when they said unto me, Let us go into the house of the LORD.
verses.pt: Alegro-me com os que me dizem: Vamos à casa do SENHOR.
verses.en_web: I was glad when they said to me, “Let’s go to Yahweh’s house!”
verses.en_bbe: <A Song of the going up. Of David.> I was glad because they said to me, We will go into the house of the Lord.

verses.en: Our feet shall stand within thy gates, O Jerusalem.
verses.pt: Nossos pés estão adentro de tuas portas, ó Jerusalém.
verses.en_web: Our feet are standing within your gates, Jerusalem;
verses.en_bbe: At last our feet were inside your doors, O Jerusalem.

verses.en: Jerusalem is builded as a city that is compact together:
verses.pt: Jerusalém está edificada como uma cidade bem unida;
verses.en_web: Jerusalem, that is built as a city that is compact together;
verses.en_bbe: O Jerusalem, you are like a town which is well joined together;

verses.en: Whither the tribes go up, the tribes of the LORD, unto the testimony of Israel, to give thanks unto the name of the LORD.
verses.pt: Para onde as tribos sobem, as tribos do SENHOR, como testemunho de Israel, para agradecerem ao nome do SENHOR.
verses.en_web: where the tribes go up, even Yah’s tribes, according to an ordinance for Israel, to give thanks to Yahweh’s name.
verses.en_bbe: To which the tribes went up, even the tribes of the Lord, for a witness to Israel, to give praise to the name of the Lord.

verses.en: For there are set thrones of judgment, the thrones of the house of David.
verses.pt: Porque ali estão as cadeiras do julgamento; as cadeiras da casa de Davi.
verses.en_web: For there are set thrones for judgment, the thrones of David’s house.
verses.en_bbe: For there seats for the judges were placed, even the rulers' seats of the line of David.

verses.en: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: they shall prosper that love thee.
verses.pt: Orai pela paz de Jerusalém; prosperem os que te amam.
verses.en_web: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem. Those who love you will prosper.
verses.en_bbe: O make prayers for the peace of Jerusalem; may they whose love is given to you do well.

verses.en: Peace be within thy walls, and prosperity within thy palaces.
verses.pt: Paz haja em teus muros, e prosperidade em tuas fortalezas.
verses.en_web: Peace be within your walls, and prosperity within your palaces.
verses.en_bbe: May peace be inside your walls, and wealth in your noble houses.

verses.en: For my brethren and companions’ sakes, I will now say, Peace be within thee.
verses.pt: Por meus irmãos e amigos, assim falarei: Paz haja em ti.
verses.en_web: For my brothers’ and companions’ sakes, I will now say, “Peace be within you.”
verses.en_bbe: Because of my brothers and friends, I will now say, Let peace be with you.

verses.en: Because of the house of the LORD our God I will seek thy good.
verses.pt: Pela Casa do SENHOR nosso Deus, buscarei o bem para ti. Cântico dos degraus:
verses.en_web: For the sake of the house of Yahweh our God, I will seek your good.
verses.en_bbe: Because of the house of the Lord our God, I will be working for your good.
